messages.subject: unmarkedFrameGMM formating error
parts:
Hi I was able to get my data into an unmarkedFrameGMM for use in the
gmultmix function but get the following error when I try to run a
model.

(oven4 <- gmultmix(~obsv1, ~sitev1, ~1, data=umfGMMoven))

Warning in data.frame(..., check.names = FALSE) :
row names were found from a short variable and have been discarded
Error in model.frame.default(phiformula, yearlySiteCovs, na.action =
NULL) :
invalid type (list) for variable 'sitev1'

I do have many NA values for sites that were not visited but am not
sure if this is causing the error.


Rob

messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Re: unmarkedFrameGMM formating error
parts: I think you need explicitly provide the column names when using data.frame(). Try this
umfGMMoven<- unmarkedFrameGMM(y=otv1, siteCovs =

data.frame(sitev1 = sitev1),obsCovs= data.frame(obsv1 = obsv1), yearlySiteCovs=
data.frame(yearJulianv1 = yearJulianv1), numPrimary=16, type="removal")

Another problem could be that your covariates do not have the correct dimensions, although there should be some built-in checks to prevent this. Could you post the results of

str(sitev1)
str(obsv1)
str(yearJulianv1)

And I just noticed an error on the unmarkedFrameGMM help page. It should be:

umfGMM1 <- unmarkedFrameGMM(y=y,
    siteCovs = data.frame(site=site),
    obsCovs=list(occasion=occasions),
    yearlySiteCovs=data.frame(year=c(t(years))), # this was wrong, fixed now
    numPrimary=T, type="removal")  
summary(umfGMM1)



Richard
